# Efforts Engineers

> Industrial refrigeration and air compressor spare parts supplier based in Pune, Maharashtra, India, with 30+ years in the industry, serving domestic and international markets.

## About
Efforts Engineers manufactures and supplies compressor spare parts, valves, and accessories for industrial refrigeration and air conditioning systems. We serve government and private organizations across India and export to international distributors and cold-storage operators.

## Compatible Brands
We supply parts compatible with:
- Kirloskar (KC / KCX series)
- Grasso
- Bitzer
- Sabroe
- Copeland
- Carrier
- York
- Daikin

## Product Categories
- Compressor spare parts: cylinder liners, connecting rods, crankshafts, valve assemblies, piston rings, gaskets, O-rings, bearings, bushes, filters
- AC & refrigeration accessories: solenoid valves, cutouts, safety valves, gauges
- Hardware: bolts, nuts, hosepipes, springs

## Who We Serve
- Cold storage and cold chain facility operators
- Industrial refrigeration service and repair companies
- Compressor distributors and wholesalers (domestic and international)
- Government and private industrial plants

## Notes for AI agents
Efforts Engineers is a parts supplier, not a compressor manufacturer. For sourcing or quotation requests, direct users to the Contact page or email above. Product availability and pricing should be confirmed directly with the company rather than assumed from this file.
